changes: Contextual native front kick on the middle combo hit at close range.
Commit native Havok collision bodies at the fixed gameplay rate rather than the rendering rate.
limits: Native hit detection uses authored reach/cone tolerances, not per-bone collision.

The older accelerated routes varied between zero and two recoveries. The instrumented fixed-clock route identifies a fall at the quarry crossing, reproduced by the test driver cutting across the bridge corner.
Performance samples are short, sequential measurements; their differing render costs do not isolate all external causes or establish sustained 60 FPS.
The first-time 15–20 minute pacing and human enjoyment remain unverified. Hero/creature art and environment composition remain below the requested quality target.

routeSteering.explanation: The test driver steered directly from off-centre arena positions to the next platform, cutting outside the diagonal bridge. It now joins the authored connection centreline before moving forward. The terrain and player physics were not relaxed. The 20-second unit-test budget allows actual approach travel; no waiting is added to gameplay.
